body:
WHAT
When the wizard saves a connection to a workspace, it deletes any `apiKeyEnv` pin from the workspace's .magentra/settings.json and, through one shared helper, from the global ~/.magentra/settings.json too. The same helper also clears contextWindow, reasoningEffort, visionConnection and vision globally when the new connection has none.

WHY
The engine merges project settings over global, so a pin left in the global file wins back the moment the project copy is removed.

WHERE
app/main.js — applyValidatedConnection(): `delete settings.apiKeyEnv` inside updateWorkspaceSettings(), staleGlobalKeys array starting with ["apiKeyEnv"], then clearGlobalSettingsKeys(staleGlobalKeys); clearGlobalSettingsKeys(keys) reads readGlobalSettings(), deletes keys and writes with writeJsonAtomic(globalSettingsPath(), …, 0o600). app/main/config.js — globalSettingsPath(), readGlobalSettings(), readEffectiveWorkspaceSettings(), updateWorkspaceSettings(), writeJsonAtomic().

TEST CHECKLIST
1. Given a global settings.json with apiKeyEnv 'DEEPINFRA_API_KEY' and a project settings.json with apiKeyEnv 'OLD', after applyValidatedConnection neither file contains an apiKeyEnv key.
2. readEffectiveWorkspaceSettings(workspace) after the save reports no apiKeyEnv (merged view is clean).
3. clearGlobalSettingsKeys(['apiKeyEnv']) on a global file without that key does not rewrite the file (mtime unchanged) and does not throw when the file is missing.
4. Saving a connection with no contextWindow / reasoningEffort also removes those keys from the global file; saving one with a contextWindow leaves a global contextWindow untouched.
5. Other keys in the global file (e.g. permissions, hooks) are preserved byte-for-byte in value and the file mode is 0600 after the rewrite (non-Windows).
